title: Library or Lecture Hall
content: Have you seen a library or lecture hall with seats arranged in a circle or semicircle in tiers surrounding a central stage? The chairs and stadium-like tiers are white. There are light wood rails. The floor is dark and carpeted on the stage and light in the seating area. The ceiling is white with a skylight. It might be domed. Among the chairs there are podiums as if people in the audience might stand up and speak. There is no audience. The empty space looks like a lecture hall but I think of it as a library every time. So, has anyone else seen it?
